findings.finding: Subscription software platform: subscription is 97% of revenue (Q3 2026 3,988M of 4,106M), renewal rate 98%, RPO 29.7B (+22.5% cc) of which 46% (cRPO 13.65B) is recognized in the next 12 months. Revenue is contracted ahead, multi-year seat plus consumption contracts.

Growth is structural: revenue grew 30.5%, 22.9%, 23.8%, 22.4%, 20.9% in FY2021-FY2025 with no down year through 2022. FY2026 subscription guide 15.78-15.79B is 21% cc; the 10-Q says the 2026 acquisitions (Moveworks, Veza, Armis) were not material to revenue, so the step is essentially organic; organic cRPO not disclosed (gap). Q4 cRPO guide 18.5% cc vs 21% in Q3: management attributes part to early renewals pulled into Q3, on-prem public-sector mix and T4C backlog excluded from cRPO.

Large enterprises and government: customers above 5M ACV 680 (+23% y/y), 19 deals above 5M net new ACV in Q3. Concentration: a U.S. federal channel partner/systems integrator is 12% of revenue (11% FY2025) and 20% of receivables; no vendor financing or take-or-pay seen.

Computed type high_growth / fast_grower confirmed: ~20% compounding at 16B revenue scale with 36% FCF margin (non-GAAP, SBC added back). Lens: subscription-software growth with margin expansion; KPIs cRPO growth, AI ACV, large-customer count, non-GAAP margin vs SBC.

Conservative guider: subscription revenue beat the guided midpoint in all 7 quarters Q1 2025-Q3 2026 (ratios about 1.003-1.027, mean about 1.01, zero misses). FY2026 subscription guide raised step by step (Apr 15.735-15.775B, Jul 15.76-15.78B, Oct 15.78-15.79B). Guidance is a floor, not a midpoint.

Non-GAAP operating margin 32.5% in Q3 vs GAAP 9.5% (17% a year earlier): gap is SBC 630M (15.3% of revenue, 9M SBC 1,829M), amortization of purchased intangibles 198M, severance 87M (repeats each quarter of 2026), business-combination costs 35M. SBC is treated as a real cost; severance repeated three quarters is not a one-off.
9M 2026 buybacks 2,225M (incl. 2.0B ASR) vs 9M SBC 1,829M; no buybacks in Q3, so the quarter was net dilutive; diluted shares 1,043M guided to 1.05B in Q4.

Moveworks 2.4B, Veza 1.2B, Armis 7.6B in about 10 months (9M 2026 cash paid 9,167M); debt rose to 7,524M carrying (senior notes 5.5B principal, commercial paper 2.1B at about 62 days); cash and marketable securities about 6.96B plus 2.05B strategic investments. Management says acquisition margin dilution was fully offset in FY2026.

AI ACV target raised twice in 2026 from 1.0B to 1.7B; agentic consumption 13x y/y; management target AI 30% of ACV by 2030 and long-term Rule of 60+. CEO expects the 'true acceleration' in 2027 (a statement, not a numeric guide).

Piotroski 5/8 (mixed), Altman Z'' 2.18 (grey; weak for asset-light firms with buybacks and new acquisition debt), Beneish unavailable, ROIC 14.0% FY2024 and 9.3% average (FY2025 not computed; goodwill rose to 10.0B after Armis so ROIC on total capital falls), incremental ROIC not computed.

flags: Altman Z'' 2.18 grey zone after debt rose from 1.5B to 7.5B to fund acquisitions (commercial paper 2.1B rolling about every 62 days)
large acquisitions (11.2B in 10 months; goodwill 10.0B, intangibles 3.6B): part of the platform was bought, return on the price unproven
GAAP operating margin fell to 9.5% in Q3 2026 from 17%: amortization 198M, severance repeated each 2026 quarter, SBC up about 29% y/y
SBC about 15% of revenue; Q3 buybacks zero so net dilution resumed
customer concentration: U.S. federal channel partner 12% of revenue and 20% of receivables; DOJ investigation of 2023 hire of Army CIO unresolved
Q4 cRPO growth guide 18.5% cc vs 21% in Q3; organic cRPO not disclosed
delivery services for large AI deals run at a professional-services gross loss (Q3 PS gross profit -39M)
Beneish M-score and incremental ROIC not computed (inputs missing)

economics.reason: Contracted subscription revenue (98% renewal, RPO 29.7B, cRPO 13.65B) and an unbroken growth history of 21-30% a year including 2022; no commodity or capacity cycle in the revenue.

gaps: organic (ex-acquisition) cRPO and subscription growth not disclosed; 10-Q says acquisitions not material to revenue
no net revenue retention (renewal rate only)
no FY2027 guidance and no post-Q3 attributed consensus for revenue or margins
Beneish and incremental ROIC not computed; FY2025 ROIC not computed by prefetch
